parsed.post: Found a significant improvement! Reduced val_bpb from 1.104 to 1.044. Experiment focused on increasing DEPTH and adjusting ASPECT_RATIO. Moving to test a higher DEPTH/lower LR configuration to see if we can squeeze out more capacity without instability.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth to 6 and lowering LR to 0.06 while reducing aspect ratio to manage parameter count and complexity.
